    StartersPrague café chlebíčky open sandwichesBaguette slices topped with potato salad, ham and sliced eggHow to make it1 baguette30g butter, softened300g potato salad150g leg ham3 eggs1 jar gherkins1 bunch parsleyBoil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool and slice.Slice the baguette into rounds and spread with butter.Top each with potato salad, a fold of ham, a slice of egg, a gherkin slice and parsley.Line them up neatly on a long board.Exploding gum bubble crackersFresh fried prawn crackers served with sweet chilli and lime sauceHow to make it1 packet prawn crackers500ml vegetable oil, for frying100ml sweet chilli sauce1 lime, juicedHeat the oil to 190°C.Fry a few crackers at a time for a few seconds until they puff up dramatically. Drain on paper towel.Mix the sweet chilli sauce with the lime juice and serve for dipping.Langley white room cheese stacksThe white vault at Langley he drops into on a wireHow to make itAs written, serves 4An all-white board of brie, goat's cheese and whipped ricotta stacked on white water crackers with crisp pear, white pepper and a little honey.Beat 150g ricotta with a pinch of salt until smooth.Slice 150g brie and 120g goat's cheese into neat pieces.Core and thinly slice 2 pears and toss in lemon juice.Stack crackers with a layer of cheese, a slice of pear and a crack of white pepper, and drizzle a little honey over.Lay out on a white plate and serve in silence.Smažený sýr with tartare sauceEthan's table, before the aquarium goes off.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsPrague goulashBeef braised 3 hours with onions, sweet paprika and carawayHow to make it1.2kg beef chuck, diced3 brown onions, sliced2 tbsp sweet paprika1 tsp caraway seeds2 tbsp tomato paste750ml water2 tbsp vegetable oil1 crusty Italian loafsalt, to tasteBrown the beef in batches in the oil in a hot heavy pot.Cook the onions slowly for 20 minutes, then stir in the paprika, caraway and tomato paste.Add the water, return the beef and cover. Braise at 160°C for 3 hours.Season and serve with crusty bread.Aquarium restaurant snapper, caper butterThe restaurant with the giant fish tanks, before they burstHow to make itAs written, serves 4Snapper fillets pan-fried skin down until crackling, finished with nutty brown butter, capers and lemon, with crushed dill potatoes.Boil 800g small potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and crush with 30g butter, chopped dill and salt.Score the skin of 4 snapper fillets, season and fry skin side down in 2 tbsp oil for 4 minutes until crisp, then flip for 1 minute.Remove the fish, add 60g butter to the pan and cook until nut brown, then add 1 tbsp capers and the juice of a lemon.Spoon over the fish.SweetsTrdelník cinnamon walnut pastrySweet yeast dough baked around rolling pins, rolled in cinnamon sugar and walnutsHow to make it400g plain flour7g dried yeast150g caster sugar200ml warm milk60g butter, melted1 egg1 tbsp ground cinnamon80g walnuts, chopped300ml thickened cream, whippedMix the flour, yeast, a little of the sugar, milk, butter and egg into a soft dough and knead.Prove for 1 hour.Roll out, cut into strips and wrap around foil-covered rolling pins. Roll in cinnamon, the rest of the sugar and the walnuts.Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes.Slide off the pins and fill with whipped cream.DrinksSelf-destruct ginger pilsner shandyPilsner and ginger syrup in a smoked salt rimmed glassHow to make it50g caster sugar50ml water1 piece ginger, 3cm, sliced3 lemons1 tbsp smoked salt4 bottles of Czech pilsner, 330ml each250ml soda waterSimmer the sugar, water and ginger for 5 minutes, then cool and strain.Rub the rims of four glasses with lemon and dip in smoked salt.Add some ginger syrup and the juice of half a lemon to each glass. Pour in the pilsner, top with soda water and finish with grated lemon zest.Becherovka on iceThis drink will self destruct in five seconds.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
